request.note: Tetris minimal-board refinement exposed a responsive-layout gap: portable client fixes the canvas to 800x450 and normal launches force a shared fullscreen preference. A portrait board-first game inverse-maps native screen dimensions into Scene coordinates to fill letterbox margins while keeping shared timing/input/storage. Add optional game-owned logical dimensions or a responsive viewport contract and default window preference, preserving existing consumers. Repro: games/tetris/src/presentation.rs; learning L-318.
